issues.explanation: The title typography uses hardcoded values that differ from the design system's H4 token provided in the reference. Updating to H4 ensures consistency with the app's heading styles.
issues.fixedCode:
fontSize: 28, // typography.h4
    fontWeight: '400', // typography.h4
    lineHeight: 40, // typography.h4

issues.explanation: The message text size should align with the bodyXs token from the design system reference.

screenLevelIssues.explanation: The 'Get Started' button in the simulator lacks the brand orange border (#FF9A6D) and the specific orange-brown shadow (#995C41) required by the design comments. It currently renders with a default neutral/white border and no visible colored glow/shadow.
screenLevelIssues.fixedCode:
<PrimaryButton
              title="Get Started"
              onPress={handleGetStarted}
              showDivider={true}
              testID="get-started-button"
              style={{
                borderColor: FIGMA_COLORS.buttonBorder,
                borderWidth: 1,
                shadowColor: FIGMA_COLORS.buttonShadow,
                shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 6 },
                shadowOpacity: 0.5,
                shadowRadius: 12,
                elevation: 10,
              }}
            />
